title:
POV: I MET A MAN IN JAMAICA
WHO LOST HIS HOME
beats: HOOK: 'What's your dream for your birthday?'
'see if I could get a bicycle' / 'A bicycle?' / 'Okay, let's make that happen'
'So what do you guys say? We're going to buy this guy a bicycle?'
'alright guys, we'll be back with the bicycle'
IN THE CAR — HIS STORY: 'the hurricane ... three years to build ... in a minute it's all gone'
BIKE SHOP: 'we're buying him a bicycle' / 'matching your shirt?' — both smiling
HIM USING IT: 'What do you think? New bike, who this?'
HOW HAPPY HE IS: 'the happiest time ... you guys bring full enjoyment to my life'
HIS MESSAGE (ending): 'Just continue. Do good. Leave negative thoughts.'
